## Summary

Describe the problem and the completed change.

## Change type

- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Backward-compatible feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Refactor or maintenance
- [ ] Documentation or tests only

## Version

- [ ] `mod_version` follows `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`.
- [ ] The bump was calculated from the latest target-branch version.
- [ ] `MAJOR` was used for an incompatible change.
- [ ] `MINOR` was used for a backward-compatible feature.
- [ ] `PATCH` was used for a backward-compatible fix.
- [ ] No version bump is required because this change is not releasable mod
      behavior.

New version or reason for no bump:

## Validation

- [ ] Work was performed on a topic branch, not directly on `main` or `master`.
- [ ] `.\gradlew.bat build` or `./gradlew build` passes after the version change.
- [ ] The final diff contains no unrelated changes, secrets, or generated files.
